metaTitle: How to Choose a Camping Axe or Hatchet
description: Choose a camping axe or hatchet by handle length, head weight and handle material, with safety rules, sharpening tips and firewood regulations.
directAnswer: A camp axe with a 24-inch handle and 1.5 to 2 pound head suits most campers, a hatchet suits kindling, and a splitting axe suits large rounds. Pick a forged head and sheath, keep a 10-foot clear circle and follow firewood rules.
